description: This source file defines the TvIndexActivity class, which is an Android Activity for a TV app. It sets up UI elements such as buttons and a WebView for displaying HTML content. It also handles navigation to other activities and manages focus and key events for TV remote control.

classes.description: Main activity for TV interface displaying an index HTML and buttons for navigation.
